source_snapshot: The repository commit containing this report
machine: Shared x86_64 Linux host, AMD EPYC 9754, 384 online logical CPUs
python: CPython 3.13.12, release standalone PyO3 extension, system allocator
coefficient_grouping: Four FIFO entries; each Laurent tag consumed once per entry; bitwise inputs including signed zeros
notes: No benchmark processes from this audit ran concurrently; other users' work was not stopped.
Prepared evaluator loading and outer compilation are excluded from warmed timings and logged separately.
Rust and Fortran include a finite-coefficient checksum in timing; Python checks all outputs and checksums outside timing.
Python includes input conversion and result-object allocation, but excludes prepared input lists and final output destruction.
Four full 1024-row batches and a one-row tail are timed in every 1024-row repetition.
The 1.5x target is per workload, not an aggregate mean or a universal-domain guarantee.
